rationale: After breaking out to a new session high of $46.74, price stalled at a double top on 1-minute bars and suffered an immediate high-volume rejection candle (28,153 shares vs. 4,000–13,500 on preceding bars) that erased most of the move and pushed price back below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($46.34). Exiting now captures the remaining gain and protects capital against a failed breakout round-trip while avoiding a counter-trend short against a high-relative-volume gap up.
